title: Render-assert hero — atomic e-div-block > (e-heading[1 LOCAL style] + e-button[GLOBAL class s01hero]); the M1 standing guard that a saved+primed atomic page renders STYLED
_comment: WP-Q06 render-assertion fixture (14-fixtures-harness.md §3 step 3 / RESEARCH §9.3f, the S01/M1 regression). REUSES the [S01] frozen atomic-hero shape (spec/spikes/fixtures/s01-atomic-hero.json) so M1 shares one shape with WP-Q01's hero. The heading carries ONE LOCAL style (the `styles` map key `e-rahead-local`, mirrored into settings.classes.value so it does not detach — R4/§5.1) whose desktop variant declares color + font-size; the button references the GLOBAL class `s01hero` (registered into the kit by the Q06 PHP suite from the frozen s01 definition: background-color rgb(255,0,128) + padding). EXPECTED SELECTOR RULES the render-assertion asserts (read STRUCTURALLY from the primed CSS, robust to whitespace/minification): LOCAL → `.elementor .<savedLocalId>{font-size:48px;color:rgb(0,128,255)}` in local-<postId>-frontend-desktop.css; GLOBAL → `.elementor .s01hero{...background-color:rgb(255,0,128)...}` in global-<postId>-frontend-desktop.css; plus a non-empty base-desktop.css. [R5]: the local-style id is REGENERATED on save (Document_Writer mints ids + Elementor re-IDs dependent local styles), so the extractor re-reads the ACTUAL id from the saved _elementor_data — it NEVER asserts the authored `e-rahead-local`. [R8]: every prop value is a TYPED {$$type,value} envelope verified against the live Elementor 4.1.1 validator. expect.valid:true (the §4 meta-invariant; prefilter defers to PHP).
